[color=#cccccc] ﻿"I always had the dream of creating a mod, I never imagined that I would be able to for stardew valley. A game that enchanted me from hair to toe. From its creation process, to the modding. I found in Stardew Valley a very welcoming community and willing to teach new people. With a vast encyclopedia of forums and wikis, not so easy to find, but which serve as a great help for people new to the business, like me.
﻿Today I can finally say that I created a mod. It was hours and hours working on it, alone, like Eric Barone. I hope people can like it, it was made with a lot of love and dedication for you, the player. Don't give up on your goals, however difficult and time consuming it may be, at some point you get there, and when you get there you realize how beautiful and empowering the climb was. And may it serve as an incentive for the search for knowledge. I feel grateful to be able to do it and I hope you enjoy playing it. It's not very perfect, I still have skills to improve.
﻿I'm a beginner, but I don't intend to stop here."[/color]
﻿
﻿My sincere thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]SpaceChase[/url]﻿, and all those who provided support materials and influenced me to enter the world of development.
﻿Once again, thank you very much for reading this and I sincerely hope you enjoy New Update Village by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/122057158]DuduBertol[/url]﻿!

([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6529]Expanded Preconditions Utility[/url]﻿,

3. Always stay tuned for new mod updates. Update them frequently to avoid errors and bugs. Smapi will let you know as soon as a mod is out of date ﻿so you can update.

5. Enjoy!

New Update Village is a new custom location added in Stardew Valley by me. I want to update her much more, adding new shops, new houses and,
 in the future, new NPCs. 
[spoiler]

[b]BACKWOODS: [/b][spoiler]
It is located and identified in the backwoods, on the path above the farm, towards Robin's Carpentry. You will see a 
small entrance on the mountain, followed by a nameplate.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862289-657700059.png[/img]﻿
[/spoiler]


[b]NUV RAILWAY STATION: [/b][spoiler]
Upon entering, you will be redirected to a train station that will transport you to the city.
It is not necessary to buy tickets for tickets, they are just decorative. To be transported to the city, just right click on the carts.
It works every day and every hour.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862302-1025896253.png[/img]﻿
[/spoiler]


[b]NEW UPDATE VILLAGE: [/b][spoiler]
New Update Village is a town created by me and specifically for shopping.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862325-1187814105.png[/img]﻿


[b]ENTRY of NUV:[/b]
When you arrive in the city, you get out of the carts and head down the road to 
the shops. A street sign identifies the city, followed by a central park and then the shops.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862343-2093958848.png[/img]﻿


[b]RIGHT of NUV:[/b]
 To your right you can find the food court, with two stores, a Tavern and an Acai store.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862358-1354421725.png[/img]﻿


[b]LEFT of NUV:
[/b]On the left above are the commerce stores, with also two stores, one for Seeds and one for Clothing.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862374-1705693447.png[/img]﻿
[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]



[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862381-1387606747.png[/img]

New Update Village is a village specifically for shopping. Here, so far, 4 new stores are added, which are arranged separately in the city.
﻿[spoiler]
To the [b]RIGHT [/b]of the city is located in the food court, with the [b]Tavern[/b] and the [b]Açaí Store[/b].

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862393-617023251.png[/img]

[b]TAVERN﻿: [/b][spoiler]
The Tavern, called the "Oblivion Tavern", is a kind of bar or restaurant, with tables and chairs for your customers to stay in the best comfort. No NPCs yet, but the sales place is in great condition for your purchase. Your drink or food will come at the best point for consumption, I'm sure!

([b]OUTSIDE[/b])
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862425-1398697083.png[/img]

([b]INSIDE[/b])
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862410-2040245229.png[/img]﻿﻿
[/spoiler]


[b]AÇAÍ STORE: [/b][spoiler]
Acai Store, called like that, is a store totally focused on selling of Acai, both in the form of fruit and in the form of ice cream. It presents a vast buffet for its customers to serve themselves in the best way they would like. Also does not have NPC, but the sales clerk will do all his role.

([b]OUTSIDE[/b])
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862445-874609390.png[/img]

([b]INSIDE[/b])

[/spoiler]



To the [b]LEFT [/b]of the city are the shops, with the Seed Store and the Clothing Store.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862457-184860562.png[/img]﻿

[b]SEEDS HERE: [/b][spoiler]
The Seeds Store, called "Seeds Here", is the market of the city. In it you will be able to find everything related to seeds, vegetables, vegetables and fruits added by the mod. Your shelves are equipped with the best and more varied products to satisfy you! Attention, as the seeds are only sold in their growing season, the other items are sold throughout the whole year. It also has no NPCs.

([b]OUTSIDE[/b])
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862477-1409353715.png[/img]

([b]INSIDE[/b])
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10486/10486-1646862469-946073509.png[/img]﻿
[/spoiler]


[b]GOOD TASTE CLOTHING:[/b] [spoiler]
The Clothing Store, called "Roupas de Bom Taste", is a store totally dedicated to the clothing of its customer. From the best quality shirts and pants, to the latest fashion and generation boots. It has no NPCs, but it is arranged with 3 vendors. All of them are identified by a sign, the first sells the boots, the second the shirts and the third the pants.
